proposed_minimal_cap_reduction.one_cause_card: RT4 timeline commit-path port of the ten exact timeline-clip-replacement tests (single quarantine group)
proposed_minimal_cap_reduction.why_minimal: One cause card resolves one registry group whose exact node count equals the ten-ID overage; fewer than ten IDs cannot meet the numerical cap. This is a proposed lower bound, not a claim the card is already feasible or sufficient for K1b metadata acceptance.
caveats: The current direct replace-clip API is retired and a one-to-one replacement operation for all ten cases is not established by this read-only trace.
Removing xfail declarations alone does not preserve their positive and error-contract assertions.

Even after reducing the count to ten, every remaining strict xfail still lacks required issue URL, owner and expiry, so K1b would remain red unless provenance supplies metadata or behavior is repaired.
The stale exact ID absent from current file can be cleared separately because commit 925a7dd intentionally removed the test in favor of live refusal controls.
